disclaimer: Fictional records for the ResolveNest demo. Not real customers, people or support conversations.

records.subject: PDF export cuts off right-hand columns
records.description: Our weekly store performance report has 16 columns. Since the update last week the PDF export only shows the first 12 columns; the rest are missing. Screen view is fine.
records.internal_notes: Reproduced with a 14-column report on 2.1.0.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.1.1. Customer confirmed full-width PDFs after their upgrade.

records.subject: Weekly fleet report not delivered on Monday
records.description: The Monday 07:00 fleet utilisation report did not arrive for any recipient. Previous weeks were fine.
records.internal_notes: Matches legacy tracker item BUG-190 (mail relay retry). That item was archived before the tracker export.
records.resolution: Report re-sent manually. Mail relay retry fix was already deployed.

records.subject: Clinicians stuck in a login redirect loop
records.description: About a third of our users bounce between our identity provider and Ledgerline when signing in with SSO. Clearing cookies does not help.
records.internal_notes: SAML trace shows NotBefore about 2.5 minutes ahead of our clock.
records.resolution: Customer re-synced IdP clock as a workaround. Permanent fix in 2.2.1, deployed to their dedicated environment on 2026-05-14.

records.subject: Dashboard filters reset when going back
records.description: When we drill into a chart and then press Back, every filter on the dashboard is cleared. Our analysts have to set region and quarter again each time.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.2.1.

records.subject: Claims summary report arrived twice on Sunday
records.description: Our 02:00 claims summary was delivered twice on Sunday 29 March. Recipients are confused which one is correct.
records.internal_notes: EU daylight-saving switch on 2026-03-29.
records.resolution: Both copies were identical. Scheduler fix shipped in 2.2.0.

records.subject: 403 Forbidden when calling /v2/reports
records.description: Our LMS integration gets HTTP 403 with error 'insufficient_scope' on GET /v2/reports. GET /v2/accounts works with the same token.
records.internal_notes: Token only has accounts:read. Not a product defect.
records.resolution: Configuration: token was missing the reports:read scope. Sent KB-015; customer issued a new token and confirmed access.

records.subject: Member import fails: unexpected column
records.description: Importing our member list fails with 'Unexpected column \ufeffaccount_id'. The file is a CSV saved from our spreadsheet tool.
records.internal_notes: Workaround from KB-009 (save without BOM) sent.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.3.0; confirmed by customer after their upgrade.

records.subject: Role with no permissions could be saved
records.description: An admin created a role without ticking any permission. Users with that role see an empty workspace. Shouldn't the editor block this?
records.resolution: Product decided this is intended behaviour (wontfix). Pointed customer to KB-007.

records.subject: CSV columns in a different order than on screen
records.description: I dragged the 'Campaign' column to the front in the report viewer, but the exported CSV still has it in position 5.
records.resolution: Customer accepted the workaround (reorder in report definition). Bug remains open.

records.subject: Duplicate rows when paginating /v2/transactions
records.description: Our billing sync pulls 500 rows per page and ends up with duplicate transaction rows at every page boundary.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.3.0.

records.subject: Order webhooks arriving 10-15 minutes late
records.description: Since Tuesday our order.created webhooks arrive 10-15 minutes after the order is placed. Normally it is under 10 seconds.
records.internal_notes: Delivery logs show first attempts on time and several 503 responses from the receiver. Delays stopped on their own after two days. Root cause not identified.
records.resolution: Delays no longer observed. No root cause identified.

records.subject: Scheduled report email missing attachment
records.description: The monthly patient volume report email arrives with the text body but no attachment. The report has about 80,000 rows.
records.internal_notes: Attachment is 14 MB. Workaround: send as download link (KB-011).

records.subject: API returns 403 after token rotation
records.description: Our nightly ETL started failing with 403 'insufficient_scope'. Scopes have not changed. The token was created 90 days ago.
records.internal_notes: Token expired; API should have returned 401 token_expired.
records.resolution: Customer issued a new token. Misleading status code tracked as BUG-244 (still open).

records.subject: Dashboard numbers lag behind source data
records.description: Policy counts on the underwriting dashboard are up to 15 minutes behind the source system even after the dataset refresh completes.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.3.1.

records.subject: New hire cannot sign in with SSO
records.description: A new finance analyst gets 'User not assigned to this application' from our identity provider when opening Ledgerline.
records.resolution: Configuration: user was not assigned to the Ledgerline app in the customer's IdP. Pointed to KB-005.

records.subject: 403 on every API call from new integration server
records.description: We moved our meter data integration to a new server. Every request now returns 403 Forbidden. The same token works from a laptop on the office network.
records.internal_notes: Error body: 'ip_not_allowed'. Source IP not on the organization allowlist.
records.resolution: Configuration: added the new server IP to the API allowlist per KB-016.

records.subject: CSV export downloads an empty file
records.description: Since this week's update, exporting the 'Driver hours by depot' report to CSV shows 'Export failed (ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE)' and downloads a 0 KB file. Exporting the same report to XLSX works.
records.internal_notes: Report includes custom date field 'Shift Start'. Reproduced on 2.3.0.
records.resolution: Fixed by the 2.3.2 rollout. Customer confirmed CSV exports work again.

records.subject: ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE on monthly revenue report
records.description: CSV export of our monthly revenue report fails with ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE. Other reports export fine. Started after the 2.3.0 release.
records.internal_notes: Failing report has custom date field 'Invoice Paid On' with empty values.
records.resolution: Workaround (XLSX) used until 2.3.2. Customer confirmed fixed on 2026-08-06.

records.subject: Import progress stuck at 99%
records.description: Course enrolment imports sit at 99% forever. The records do appear in the system afterwards.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.3.1.

records.subject: Scheduled CSV attachment is 0 bytes
records.description: Our daily claims export email now has an empty claims.csv attachment. We are on 2.3 since the weekend.
records.internal_notes: Scheduler log shows ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE on custom field 'Loss Date'.
records.resolution: Fixed by the 2.3.2 rollout.

records.subject: Japanese text shows as boxes in PDF
records.description: Campaign names in Japanese are rendered as empty squares in PDF exports. They display correctly in the browser.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.4.0.

records.subject: Can't select reports:write scope when creating a token
records.description: As an org admin I need a service token with reports:write for our gradebook sync, but the scope is not in the list.
records.internal_notes: Workaround: create token via POST /v2/tokens.
records.resolution: Fixed in 2.3.1.

records.subject: Webhook deliveries delayed by about 20 minutes
records.description: During business hours our shipment.updated webhooks arrive around 20 minutes late. Overnight they are near real time.
records.internal_notes: Collecting delivery log samples.

records.subject: CSV export broken since upgrade
records.description: We upgraded our dedicated environment to 2.3.0 on Monday. Since then CSV exports of the 'Stock by store' report fail with ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE.
records.internal_notes: Custom date field 'Last Delivery'. Workaround from KB-012 sent.
records.resolution: Customer upgraded to 2.3.2 on 2026-08-18 and verified exports.

records.subject: HTTP 403 from /v2/accounts for service user
records.description: Our core banking connector uses a service user and gets 403 on /v2/accounts. The token has accounts:read.
records.internal_notes: Service user's role lacks the 'Accounts: view' permission. Token scope cannot exceed role permissions.
records.resolution: Configuration: granted 'Accounts: view' to the service role. Sent KB-007 and KB-015.

records.subject: CSV export times out on full-year transactions
records.description: Exporting all 2025 transactions (about 1.2 million rows) fails after two minutes with 'Export timed out'. Quarterly exports work.
records.internal_notes: Different error from ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE. Workaround per KB-014.

records.subject: CSV export fails with error code after upgrade
records.description: After our upgrade to v2.3.1 the 'Appointments by clinic' CSV export fails with ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE. XLSX works.
records.internal_notes: Customer's change board has not yet approved 2.3.2. Using XLSX workaround.

records.subject: Users lose admin role after nightly sync
records.description: Every morning several grid operations admins are downgraded to Viewer. Their IdP group is 'Ops/Admins'.
records.resolution: Customer renamed groups as a workaround; fixed in 2.4.0.

records.subject: 403 Forbidden using personal access token
records.description: I created a personal token and every API call returns 403. Docs say it should work.
records.internal_notes: Error body: 'plan_not_entitled'. Starter plan has no API access.
records.resolution: Not a defect: API access requires the Business plan. Shared upgrade options.

records.subject: Webhook deliveries delayed by about 20 minutes
records.description: During business hours our shipment.updated webhooks arrive around 20 minutes late. Overnight they are near real time.
records.internal_notes: Sampled deliveries left our dispatcher on time; customer receiver responded slowly (8-12 s) during peaks. Not conclusive.
records.resolution: Delays subsided after the customer scaled their receiver. Root cause not confirmed.

records.subject: Some webhook events delayed up to 40 minutes
records.description: A subset of enrolment.completed webhooks arrive 20-40 minutes late. Most arrive within seconds.
records.internal_notes: Could this be BUG-247? Receiver returned 503 with Retry-After: 30 during the window. Unconfirmed; engineering has not linked it.

records.subject: Revenue widget shows yesterday's numbers
records.description: The premium revenue widget still shows yesterday's total at 11:00, while the dataset shows today's refresh completed at 07:00.
records.internal_notes: Looks like BUG-219 at first glance, but that was fixed in 2.3.1. Widget had a 'cache for 24 hours' override.
records.resolution: Configuration: removed the 24-hour widget cache override.

records.subject: Report email missing PDF attachment
records.description: The monthly fleet costs PDF is no longer attached to the scheduled email. The email arrives with only the text body.
records.internal_notes: PDF is 11.4 MB.

records.subject: Can't export CSV of loan portfolio report
records.description: Loan portfolio report CSV export fails with ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE after our upgrade to 2.3.0 last weekend. Regulators need this file monthly.
records.internal_notes: Custom date field 'Maturity Date'. XLSX workaround used for the August filing.
records.resolution: Customer upgraded to 2.3.2 on 2026-08-27 and confirmed CSV export works.

records.subject: CSV export error after weekend maintenance
records.description: One of our planners says CSV export 'stopped working' after the weekend. No error message or report name provided.
records.internal_notes: Possibly BUG-231, but no error code, report name or custom fields could be confirmed. Could not reproduce with sample reports.
records.resolution: Closed after two follow-ups without customer response.

records.subject: Order webhooks arriving late and out of order
records.description: order.updated events sometimes arrive before order.created and up to 25 minutes late during the evening peak.
records.internal_notes: Sampled events show on-time first attempts with 429 responses from the receiver; retries arrived later. Ordering is not guaranteed by design (see KB-018).
records.resolution: Explained retry and ordering behaviour. Delays could not be reproduced on our side.

records.subject: 403 when exporting via API with read-only token
records.description: POST /v2/exports returns 403 'insufficient_scope' even though our token has reports:read.
records.internal_notes: Creating exports requires exports:create. Working as designed.
records.resolution: Configuration: added exports:create scope. Sent KB-015.

records.subject: SAML assertion rejected: NotBefore in the future
records.description: Sign-ins fail for everyone with 'Assertion not yet valid'. Started this morning.
records.internal_notes: IdP clock was 6 minutes ahead after a failed NTP update, beyond the 3-minute tolerance added for BUG-212.
records.resolution: Configuration: customer fixed NTP on the IdP host per KB-005.

records.subject: Customer list import failing on encoding
records.description: Import of our supplier master file fails with 'Invalid character in row 1'.
records.internal_notes: File is UTF-16 LE, not UTF-8.
records.resolution: Configuration: asked customer to save the file as UTF-8 (KB-009). Import succeeded.

records.subject: Webhook delays since last week
records.description: Our Slack-style notifier receives campaign.published events late, sometimes by 10 minutes.
records.internal_notes: No endpoint URL or event IDs provided.
records.resolution: Closed without customer response.

records.subject: Intermittent 403 from API
records.description: About half of our API calls return 403. Retrying sometimes works.
records.internal_notes: Two worker pools use different tokens; one token was revoked by a departing admin.
records.resolution: Configuration: replaced the revoked token in the second worker pool.

records.subject: Dashboards blank in Safari
records.description: Since yesterday all dashboards show an empty page for our Mac users on Safari. Chrome works.

records.subject: Daily attendance report skipped every other day
records.description: Our daily 06:00 attendance report (Pacific/Auckland) did not run this morning, Tuesday 29 September. It ran fine last week.
records.internal_notes: NZ moved to UTC+13 on 2026-09-27.

records.subject: Webhook delivery latency spikes
records.description: Latency for dataset.refreshed webhooks spikes to 15-30 minutes a few times a week. We suspect the queue migration in 2.3.0.
records.internal_notes: Customer suspects the 2.3.0 queue migration, but similar delays were reported before 2.3.0 (TCK-1011). No common cause established.

records.subject: 403 after enabling SSO enforcement
records.description: After we enabled 'Require SSO for all users', our stock sync integration gets 403 on every call.
records.internal_notes: Integration authenticates with a legacy user API key, which SSO enforcement disables.
records.resolution: Configuration: moved integration to a scoped service token per KB-015.

records.subject: Auditor role can't see the export button
records.description: Our external auditors can view reports but the Export menu is missing for them.
records.resolution: Configuration: the Auditor role lacked 'Reports: export'. Sent KB-007.

records.subject: CSV export stopped working after upgrade to 2.3
records.description: We upgraded our dedicated Ledgerline environment to 2.3 over the weekend of 24-25 October. Since then CSV export of the 'Finance Close - Accruals' report fails: users see 'Export failed (ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE)' and the downloaded file is 0 KB. The report includes our custom date fields 'Invoice Approved On' and 'Accrual Reversal Date'. Exporting the same report to XLSX works. Month-end close starts on 3 November, so this is urgent for our finance team. Have other customers seen this?
records.internal_notes: New ticket, awaiting L2 triage. Exact patch version not stated by the customer.

records.subject: Webhooks delayed 5-10 minutes
records.description: outage.reported webhooks are reaching our dispatch system 5-10 minutes late. This is safety relevant for us.
records.internal_notes: Delivery logs requested. Receiver is behind a corporate proxy that sometimes returns 502.

records.subject: 403 on /v2/webhooks endpoint
records.description: Trying to register a webhook via the API returns 403 'insufficient_scope'.
records.resolution: Configuration: token was missing the webhooks:manage scope. Sent KB-015.

records.subject: Need to export more than 500k rows to CSV
records.description: Year-end GPS event export (about 800,000 rows) times out. Smaller date ranges work.
records.internal_notes: Suggested asynchronous export API per KB-014.

records.subject: Is 2.3.2 required for the CSV export fix?
records.description: Our change board asks whether upgrading from 2.3.1 to 2.3.2 is sufficient to restore CSV exports, or whether we should wait for 2.4.
records.internal_notes: Question ticket related to TCK-1027. No new defect reported.
